name: APT29 Credential Access 1 - Kerberos Ticket Cache Enumeration (T1550.003 precondition)
blast_radius: Runs klist tickets and klist tgt and records only counts. No ticket is exported, saved or replayed.
detection: EDR: klist.exe from a script host

name: APT29 Credential Access 2 - Private Key File Search (T1552.004)
blast_radius: Plants synthetic key files in a run-tagged temp profile and searches that profile recursively for key-file patterns. The real profile is never searched.
detection: EDR: recursive search for id_rsa, .pfx, .pem and .key patterns

name: APT29 Credential Access 3 - Browser Credential Store Copy (T1555.003)
blast_radius: Builds a synthetic Chrome-style profile with a Login Data file and Local State, copies the store as stealers do to avoid locks, and reads its header. The real browser profile is never touched; nothing is decrypted.
telemetry: Sysmon EID 11: copy of a file named Login Data
detection: EDR: Login Data copied by a non-browser process
